Events.Description: Monthly Anonathan. Multiple BTI 3 interns attended including Kavish Dogra, Taruna, Aayushi, Tanya, Ekta, Lalita, Bhumi, Aparna.
Ridhima Singh (Main Host), Himani Pawar + Angel Kapoor + Ekta Ranjan (Moderators). Registration desk, video team, social media team — all intern-powered.
Hosted by Lalita Dubey & Shreya Gupta. 9 intern participants from all three teams.
Registration opened for the AGF Educators' Fellowship program.
5-day Summer Camp (Jun 8–13). Kyra Puri participated as a student; Connect team provided content and data support.
6 events over 6 days (22–27 Jun): Fitness Challenge · Ripple Effect · ANONTalks · Open Mic · Debate · Chronicles 13.0. 13 BTI 3 interns participated; Ridhima Singh hosted Chronicles 13.0.
Challenge concluded. Devya, Aparna, Kyra, Taruna, Renee, Himani, Angel, Tanya, Diya, Gitali, Tvisha completed the wellness challenge.
3-month internship program officially concludes. Final grades issued, certificates to be awarded, BTI 4 preparation begins.
The next batch of ANON's internship program kicks off. BTI 3 interns who created promotional reels and content helped recruit BTI 4. Some BTI 3 outstanding performers may return as mentors.
Formal recognition event for all 48 BTI 3 interns. Outstanding performers to be specially acknowledged.
The educators fellowship program that BTI 3 interns helped register and promote.
Continued from BTI 3: Delhi chapter growth, Pune website, new city chapters in pipeline.

Stories.Title: Overview
Stories.Details: BTI 3 launched in April 2026 and concluded in June — three months of sustained output across 48 interns spanning three teams.

Stories.Title: April
Stories.Details: April was defined by ANONotsav 2026 — the flagship event that saw interns step up as hosts, moderators, video editors, registration leads, and on-ground coordinators. Ridhima Singh became the main host and Ridhima Patawat led video production and fellowship moderation.

Stories.Title: May
Stories.Details: May saw record output: Ridhima Patawat delivered 14 reels (cumulative: 13 final), Saanvi Prasad produced 20 fellowship videos, and Team Expression expanded ANONTalks. The Interns Chronicles 12.0 ANONotsav Special Edition was hosted beautifully by Lalita Dubey and Shreya Gupta.

Stories.Title: June
Stories.Details: June closed the batch strong: AGF GENXT RISE Summer Camp ran from 8–13 June, the Fit & Wealthy 25-day challenge concluded on 25 June, and Wellness Week 2026 (22–27 June) brought interns across all teams together for a week-long celebration of wellbeing.
